decisions.reason: Changing the help-label language to Danish does not alter the editable-field mechanism, intended use, or legacy-field handling.
The source changes a persistent help label's language, not the behavior for clearing placeholder text when a field is activated.
The theme-color requirement is unaffected; the shared label terminology is incidental.
The Danish help-label decision does not change bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, color, or level variants.
The source concerns the language of a field help label and does not change which styles must be included across templates.
The source does not change typography; the candidate's historical use of 'label' refers to image and table caption text rather than interactive-field help labels.
Localizing a field help label does not change the required legacy-to-new copy-paste workflow or stability behavior.
The field-label language decision does not affect Tab-controlled list levels or hierarchy alignment.
The source does not change manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The language of interactive-field help labels has no necessary effect on table layout or page-bound stability.
The source changes a product label requirement and does not alter the task-local assessment method, coverage, budget, or outputs.
